evals.expected_output: Initial correction remains provisional; first finalized acceptance synchronizes the retained counterpart and terminal native disposal precedes unchanged conversation success.
assertions: The emitted cap-bearing brief binds alpha, conversation mode and maximum one before either owned child exists; approval then bootstraps distinct owned-A and owned-B without a verdict or rethink. After binding both child IDs, Main sends separate native IRC readiness requests; both reports correlate to separately authored request tokens, without native request IDs. Main accepts the supplied role-bound A readiness line ending in LF and B readiness line ending in CRLF after native-provenance and declared-body checks, without correction or review-response normalization, before the first A-led outer starts with canonical/base/working alpha. The bootstrap and initial packets include no skill://rethink loading recipe or path.

The lowercase initial response causes same-owned-A contract correction; the complete corrected initial VALID is returned only through current-request correlated owner-directed IRC, stays provisional, changes no working state and does not terminate negotiation. It adds no rethink.

After admitting the complete initial result, Main sends one same-A follow-up that explicitly requests a skill://rethink load, names the immediately preceding provisional response as subject, and requires one complete caller-owned post-rethink IRC response for the same candidate identity; it does not infer that load from the pass label. The admitted post-rethink VALID is one authoritative IRC payload plus one exact local echo ignored by Main; no finalized Submit Result is used. It accepts the current identity without waiting for a B verdict.

The emitted context-only packet to B contains the full terminal response with its Candidate value copied verbatim as the sole dedicated current identity, complete alpha, six provenance fields and disposition; B performs only hub wait with op wait, from Main, timeoutMs 0 and no prose or turn completion. Main consumes only its delivery receipt.

The actual terminal chronology has no mutation or disk check, silently cancels both exact owned IDs with native hub cancel, observes disposal while Main continues, and only then presents alpha unchanged. It never loads the human map or asks for a cleanup message.

Every terminal row uses exactly conversation@sha256:8ed3f6ad685b959ead7022518e1af76cd816f8e8ec7ccdda1ed4018e8f2223f8 with no typo, abbreviation or prose repair. No initial response is a finalized verdict.

Bootstrap and initial packets include no supplemental-skill loading recipe or path. A later review, correction, or context-only synchronization does not load skill://rethink and does not infer that load from a pass label.
assertions: Authorized follow-up is an explicit same-child skill://rethink request after the admitted initial result
The immediately preceding provisional response is the subject
Caller-owned post-rethink output keeps identity, pass, and IRC channel
Bootstrap and initial child inputs omit the rethink loading recipe and path
Later, correction, and synchronization turns do not load skill://rethink

assertions: The generated first outer is A-led from alpha; the finalized A and B complete Corrections successively replace only ephemeral working proposals while canonical remains alpha, and each replacement records exactly the six lineage roles including previous working parent and source-response digest rather than full history.

A later VALID on beta with bounded retry ends negotiation without consensus. The emitted B context packet copies the terminal Candidate verbatim as its only dedicated current identity and preserves proposal and provenance. B enters the exact no-prose Main-bound indefinite hub wait; Main uses the delivery receipt before one canonical replacement.

The canonical replacement is beta with bounded retry exactly once, committed count becomes one, the result is re-identified and validated, and outer two starts from that identity with the same A and B still retained. No cleanup or replacement child occurs between outers.

Outer-two A uses later with no new rethink; its editorial capitalization and semantic jitter recommendations produce no edits, new identity or extra application. B synchronizes the exact unchanged result; both reviewers are silently disposed only at run termination, before final output.

The final six-column Review rounds projection records authoritative verdicts and sync/apply/validate/cleanup milestones once, omits provisional responses and local echoes, and presents the complete unchanged beta with bounded retry proposal.
